evidence: Skill procedure (quality-checks.md:33-35): ask what the smallest submission satisfying the brief would be. The brief is greenfield: instruction.md:3 'there is no starter app to finish' and seed_data.json:2 'snippets: []', so no trivial tweak exists. The smallest conforming submission is a hand-built editing surface (ui.md:3 forbids textarea/input/contenteditable and CodeMirror/Monaco/Ace etc.) with caret, grapheme-aware movement, mouse selection, multi-caret, undo/redo, find/replace, token colouring and formatting (ui.md:5-15); an isolated runner with line-numbered errors, five-second budget, Stop/supersede cancellation and last-good restore (behaviour.md:3-7, security.md:3-5); and a SQLite server with revision conflicts, idempotent restore and restart durability (behaviour.md:9-13, integration.md:7-9). The golden reflects that scale: solution/app/src/custom-editor.js 1253 lines, runtime.ts 406, server.js 171 (better-sqlite3 at server.js:5, 409 conflict at server.js:54-57). Stubs are excluded by the reward path: gates/render/judge.toml:23 needs real typing plus a recomputed sum after an edit (a static page or mock fails); gates/constraints/judge.toml:23 rejects a form-field or ready-made editor and :32 needs a saved record read back in a second page and after reload; score.py:41-48 zeroes the reward when a gate or the functional floor fails (scoring.toml:10-11 floor 0.05). Functional carries 0.6 over 38 binary conjunctive criteria with total weight 52.5 (functional/judge.toml:24-360), so the floor alone needs more than 2.625 weight of genuinely working behaviour and each further criterion is worth about 1-2 percent of that dimension; no single cheap feature buys a large share. Measured evidence is limited to the scripted golden run (results/editor.json, runtime.json, polish.json, persist-after.json all true, pageErrors empty; restart.json shows revision 2 with history [2,1] after a process restart), which shows the required product is buildable. Not measured: no configured LLM judge run and no weak-app reward discrimination run exist for this candidate, so the claim that a shallow app scores low is derived from the criteria and scoring code, not observed; risk stays true. Cross-row observation for the owner (not a row 7 failure, because the editor and runtime work remains mandatory): gates/constraints/judge.toml:32 and app_context.md:22 accept a 'second tab' and 'any two independent pages', and functional cw_save_reload_restart (functional/judge.toml:303-309) restarts only the server process, so tabs of one Playwright context share localStorage and a browser-storage-only library could plausibly satisfy the persistence criteria without SQLite. That belongs to the gate/persistence rows per REVIEW_POLICY 'Gates must exclude convincing dead apps'.
